sustainabilitySubtitle: Our commitment to sustainable and ethical fashion practices reflects our belief that luxury and responsibility go hand in hand.
sustainabilityEthicalSourcingDesc1: We partner exclusively with brands that prioritize ethical manufacturing and fair labor practices. Every partner in our portfolio meets rigorous sustainability standards and maintains transparent supply chains from raw materials to finished products.
sustainabilityEthicalSourcingDesc2: Our commitment extends beyond compliance to active collaboration with artisans and manufacturers who share our values of craftsmanship and responsibility.
sustainabilityEthicalSourcingDesc3: We conduct regular audits and maintain direct relationships with production facilities to ensure continuous improvement and adherence to our ethical standards.
sustainabilityQualityDesc1: We believe that true luxury is sustainable. By curating timeless pieces and supporting slow fashion, we reduce waste and promote longevity in an industry traditionally driven by seasonal trends.
sustainabilityQualityDesc2: Each collection we represent is designed to last generations, encouraging consumers to invest in quality pieces that transcend time rather than disposable fashion.
sustainabilityQualityDesc3: Our partners focus on timeless designs, superior materials, and impeccable construction that ensures longevity and reduces the need for frequent replacements.
sustainabilityStatsEthicalDesc: All our brands meet international sustainability standards and ethical guidelines.
sustainabilityStatsZeroDesc: Committed to eliminating disposable packaging and reducing environmental impact.
sustainabilityStatsYearsDesc: Over a decade of dedicated work in sustainable fashion distribution.
preorderSubtitle: Secure your pieces before the official market release and maximize your competitive advantage with VN13 pre-order access.
preorderExclusiveAccessDesc1: Through VN13, retailers gain early access to upcoming collections before official market release. Pre-order periods allow for strategic inventory planning and securing the most sought-after pieces before they sell out.
preorderExclusiveAccessDesc2: Our pre-order process is streamlined and transparent, with detailed specifications, sizing information, pricing, and guaranteed delivery timelines for each collection.
preorderExclusiveAccessDesc3: Benefit from competitive pre-order pricing and secure your stock before competitors gain access to the collection.
preorderStrategicPlanningDesc1: We provide comprehensive market insights and trend analysis to help retailers make informed pre-order decisions. Each collection comes with detailed retail recommendations, styling suggestions, and marketing materials.
preorderStrategicPlanningDesc2: Our team works directly with retailers to understand their needs and help them select pieces that align with their customer base and market positioning.
preorderStrategicPlanningDesc3: Secure competitive pricing and maximize your margins with our flexible pre-order pricing structure and volume discounts.
preorderProcessBrowseDesc: View detailed images, specifications, and pricing for upcoming collections
preorderProcessSelectDesc: Choose specific items, sizes, and quantities for your order
preorderProcessConfirmDesc: Lock in your order with guaranteed pricing and delivery date
preorderProcessDeliverDesc: Your pre-ordered pieces arrive at your store on the guaranteed date
preorderCTATitle: Ready to Join Our Pre-Order Program?
preorderCTADesc: Contact our team to discuss your pre-order needs and access our upcoming collections.
manufacturingSubtitle: Every piece is manufactured in Europe by skilled artisans committed to exceptional quality and traditional craftsmanship.
manufacturingExcellenceDesc1: All our partner brands are manufactured in Europe, where centuries of craftsmanship traditions ensure exceptional quality. From Italy's legendary leather workshops to France's renowned textile mills, we support the continent's finest producers.
manufacturingExcellenceDesc2: This strategic commitment guarantees not only superior quality and uncompromising attention to detail but also reduces carbon footprints through local production and supports thriving economies across Europe.
manufacturingExcellenceDesc3: European manufacturing represents a commitment to standards that have been refined over generations, ensuring pieces that last a lifetime.
manufacturingCraftsmanshipDesc1: We partner exclusively with manufacturers who employ skilled artisans preserving and advancing traditional techniques. Each piece reflects generations of expertise, dedication, and an unwavering pursuit of perfection.
manufacturingCraftsmanshipDesc2: Quality control at every step ensures that only the finest pieces reach our retail partners and their discerning customers.
manufacturingCraftsmanshipDesc3: From raw material selection to final finishing, every decision prioritizes longevity, beauty, and the integrity of the craft.
manufacturingItalyDesc: Home to the world's most renowned leather goods, artisanal knitwear, and handcrafted footwear manufacturing. Italian craftsmanship is celebrated globally for precision, durability, and timeless design.
manufacturingItalySpecialties: Leather accessories, footwear, luxury knitwear, handbags
manufacturingFranceDesc: The undisputed center of haute couture and premium textile production. French manufacturers maintain the highest standards of elegance, innovation, and technical excellence in every category.
manufacturingFranceSpecialties: Haute couture, premium textiles, fine fabrics, ready-to-wear
manufacturingPortugalDesc: An emerging hub for innovative sustainable manufacturing. Portuguese producers combine time-honored traditional techniques with cutting-edge technology, creating unique opportunities.
manufacturingPortugalSpecialties: Sustainable production, innovative techniques, artisan goods
manufacturingQualityMultiDesc: Rigorous quality control at raw materials, production, and finishing stages
manufacturingQualityComplianceDesc: Adherence to ISO standards and international regulatory requirements
manufacturingQualityCertificationDesc: Full traceability and certification of all materials used in production
manufacturingQualityTestingDesc: Comprehensive testing to ensure longevity and performance standards
manufacturingEthicsLaborDesc: Competitive wages, benefits, and safe working conditions for all employees
manufacturingEthicsEnvironmentDesc: Sustainable practices including waste reduction and energy efficiency
manufacturingEthicsCommunityDesc: Active involvement in local communities and skill development programs
manufacturingEthicsImprovementDesc: Regular audits and collaboration to enhance production standards
manufacturingCTATitle: Learn More About Our Manufacturing Standards
manufacturingCTADesc: Contact our team to discuss manufacturing partnerships and visit our production facilities.
brandManuelleGuibalSubtitle: Innovative design meets French craftsmanship in every piece from Manuelle Guibal.
brandManuelleGuibalHeroDesc: Founded in Lyon, Manuelle Guibal creates bold, timeless collections using Europe's finest fabrics.
brandManuelleGuibalAboutDesc1: Manuelle Guibal is a Parisian brand renowned for its innovative construction and minimalist aesthetic. Each collection is developed with the goal of creating harmony between form, function, and material.
brandManuelleGuibalAboutDesc2: Since 2010, Manuelle and her team have been developing a unique design language that combines technical innovation with timeless craftsmanship. Collections are executed in the finest European fabrics, often using organic and sustainable materials.
brandManuelleGuibalAboutDesc3: The brand has earned recognition for its creative approach to knitwear, understanding of proportion, and unwavering commitment to quality. Each collection reflects the brand's philosophy: creating pieces that will positively impact the lives of those who wear them.
brandManuelleGuibalPhilosophyDesc: Manuelle Guibal believes in the power of well-made clothes. Design work focuses on finding the perfect balance between innovation and timelessness. Every piece is created to last years and become an essential part of a wardrobe.
brandManuelleGuibalCraftDesc: All collections are manufactured in Europe by skilled artisans who pay attention to every detail.
brandManuelleGuibalSustainabilityDesc: A commitment to sustainability is integrated into every aspect of production, from material selection to waste management.
brandManuelleGuibalInnovationDesc: Use of advanced production methods to create clothing that sets new standards for comfort and functionality.
brandManuelleGuibalCTADesc: Contact our team to learn more about Manuelle Guibal collections and partnership opportunities.
